snippet.title: Fogpiercer Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Fogpiercer is a roguelite deck-building game where the train is the deck, and your build choices determine which cards are used when fighting off hordes of unreasonably angry bandits who don’t want you reaching the end of the line. Play the right cards at the right time, and enemies can be tricked into attacking each other, pushed out of the way so their attacks miss, or even knocked in front of the train so you can crush them under the wheels. There's a world map to guide your train to salvation, and meta-progression that will make subsequent runs easier. 

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219010/Fogpiercer/
